data.revised_prompt: High-fidelity desktop web app direction comp, 1536x1024 landscape, for Glacier Signal Chinese stock evaluation workbench. Design as a professional jet-age ticket wallet made of sequential carbon-copy coupons, but clearly as an interface not retro poster art. Narrow left navigation rail; a wide primary coupon in center holding the exact text: 'Glacier Signal', '贵州茅台', '600519.SH', '等待转强', '候选评分 71 / 100'. Attached coupon sections beneath/adjacent for exact labels: '硬性过滤', '风险预算', and a purple carbon-copy risk stub on the right with exact text: '结构止损 ¥1,198.00'. Include readable voided or pending stamps on some items, but keep them integrated into the interface. Show second-fold details visible below the main coupon stack. Use carrier navy #0D1B3D, crisp white coupon stock #F8F7F2, red validation/VOID stamps #D7262D, carbon purple numerals #4B2E83, perforations and clipped ticket corners, a single condensed airline grotesque style for typography. Add subtle paper texture and printed coupon lines, but no airplane imagery, no boarding-pass novelty overload, no generic cards, no device mockup, no watermark. Professional risk-tool credibility first. Include clean grid, authentic ticket stubs, carbon-copy layers, perforation marks, fold seams, and restrained Chinese/Latin typography. Ensure all exact requested text is legible and faithfully spelled. Keep the layout as an app interface dashboard composed of ticket coupons.
